title: Pallof Press
summary: An anti-rotation press: you hold a cable straight out in front while it tries to twist you.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: cable station with an adjustable pulley.

muscles.why: Library rating 0.7 for obliques (helper): each working set adds 0.7 of a set to the weekly obliques total.
Library rating 0.5 for abs (helper): each working set adds 0.5 of a set to the weekly abs total.

setup.text: Stand side-on to a cable at chest height, holding the handle at your chest.
Press it straight out until your arms are straight, without letting your torso turn.
Hold briefly, then bring it back.

form_cues.cue: Brace like someone is about to push you sideways.

mistakes.text: Letting the torso twist toward the stack.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: Less isolation, Heavier loading potential, No anti-rotation demand.
Swap sheet: Less isolation, Less stable, One side at a time.
Swap sheet: More stretch emphasis, Less isolation, Less stable.

alternatives.goal_label: Home gym: no equipment / bar only
alternatives.why: Swap sheet: More hip-flexor work (legs lift), Less isolation, Less stable.
